style: 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, full-bleed vertical, no bands
motion_rule: HE is the subject of every window and crosses the frame edge to edge, talking windows too, always SIDEWAYS, never up or down, then straight AT the lens from 7.8; ONE action per window, only one of them moving; every move starts by ramming the glass, the coins or THE HAMSTER; camera move and a new shot size every window, never on a schedule
character: a palm-sized tarsier, grey-brown fur, thin long fingers, ENORMOUS round amber eyes, a loose office tie, reckless
second_characters: ONE grey hamster teller in cashier sleeves, a brass coin scoop in his paws, never speaking
props: ONE huge glass money jar packed with coins; loose coins; ONE brass coin scoop; his office tie
prop_continuity: the crack runs longer every window, hairline at 0.0, burst at 5.55; the jar full till 2.65, empty by 6.3, gone by 7.05; the tie stays on him all clip; speech is only heard, never shown
environment: a sunlit marble bank hall, tall windows, brass fittings

audio.language: Russian, verbatim, nothing added or repeated; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: high squeaky male voice, reckless and merry, even 4.5 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: za-CHEM, ko-PIT, ved ZHIZN, mi-mo-LYOT-nyy, po-TRAT, um-RI, BYS-tro
audio.pacing: speech 0.45-1.8 and 2.65-5.55; one pause 1.8-2.65; voiceless after 5.55, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes on every syllable, never a voice over
audio.sfx: coins pouring, glass creaking, the jar bursting, coins ringing

timeline.a: silent. THE TARSIER rams the glass jar and rakes left to right, a hairline crack forking after him, THE HAMSTER frozen beyond
THE TARSIER kicks off the counter and tears right to left, eyes huge
THE TARSIER rams the jar belly and drives left to right, the crack running longer
THE TARSIER swings right to left across the jar, tie streaming
no words. THE HAMSTER strides edge to edge and dumps a scoop of coins onto THE TARSIER
THE TARSIER bursts out of the coin heap and tears left to right, coins spraying at the lens
THE TARSIER rams the crack with both feet and slings himself right to left
THE TARSIER drives left to right along the glass, his tie whipping
THE TARSIER rams the crack head on and skids right to left, first coins jetting out
no words. The jar bursts and THE TARSIER surges left to right on the coin flood past the lens
THE TARSIER body surfs the coin wave right to left across the marble
THE HAMSTER strides edge to edge and sweeps the coins from under THE TARSIER onto bare marble
THE TARSIER charges straight AT the lens across bare marble, filling the frame
THE TARSIER skids onto his back left to right into the lens, arms crossing on his chest
THE TARSIER flicks his last coin spinning on edge at the lens by his face, it wobbles and drops flat across his open amber eye

must_appear: the crack growing every window, the hamster dumping coins at 1.8, the glass jar bursting at 5.55, the coin wave edge to edge, the charge straight at the lens, the last coin dropping flat across his open amber eye
negative_prompt: speech bubble, comic bubble, a thought balloon, cyrillic, subtitles, night, dark scene, low key, a still camera, a wide shot, a small figure, standing still, moving up or down the frame, two actions at once, two tarsiers, a frozen final frame, any word after 5.55, silence in the tail, a glowing emblem, a logo, watermark, black bands
